//: The light lane of the home-lab Argo e2e queue (#361; homelab ADR 036): one make target that needs
no kind cluster (Go tests with testcontainers, chart checks, admission tests, docs-check), on a light
slot with its own Go cache and Docker cache. hack/e2e-argo.sh --lane light fills in the parameters
and submits this as an inline Workflow; the target runs as hack/lab/light-run.sh of the bundled
commit. The slot's Block volume is in podSpecPatch (Argo adds workflow volumes only for mounts).

sidecars.name: dind
args:
set -eu
dev=/dev/docker-cache
# Kata hot-plugs the pod's memory a few seconds after start
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do [ "$(free -m | awk '/Mem/{print $2}')" -gt 9000 ] && break; sleep 2; done
# First use of the slot only: format it (busybox blkid exits 0 without a filesystem: test its output)
if [ -z "$(blkid "$dev")" ]; then apk add -q e2fsprogs; mkfs.ext4 -q -L docker-cache "$dev"; fi
mount -t ext4 "$dev" /var/lib/docker
dockerd-entrypoint.sh dockerd --host=tcp://127.0.0.1:2375 --insecure-registry=zot.zot.svc.cluster.local:5000 >/work/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do docker -H tcp://127.0.0.1:2375 info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
export DOCKER_HOST=tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
# Every run starts with no containers, networks or volumes left over; images stay cached
docker rm -f $(docker ps -aq) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker network prune -f >/dev/null; docker volume prune -af >/dev/null; docker image prune -f >/dev/null
touch /work/dockerd-ready
echo "dockerd ready: $(docker images -q | wc -l) cached images"
wait

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /work/out
for _ in $(seq 1 180); do [ -e /work/dockerd-ready ] && break; sleep 1; done
[ -e /work/dockerd-ready ] || { echo "dockerd not ready after 180 s"; cp /work/dockerd.log /work/out/ || true; exit 1; }
# The submitted values arrive as env, never pasted into this script
[[ $E2E_REF =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "ref must be a full 40-hex commit SHA"; exit 2; }
git clone -q --no-checkout /work/in/koinon.bundle /work/koinon
cd /work/koinon
git checkout -q --detach "$E2E_REF"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$E2E_REF"
exec hack/lab/light-run.sh "$E2E_TARGET"
